text: According to a tender addendum filed with the Ministry of Civic Works on Tuesday, the Ninefold Stadium roof was designed by Leona Vasquez-Hart, the principal architect at Marrow & Tine. The filing, reviewed by The Continental Record, credits Vasquez-Hart with the roof’s “radial tension lattice” and its curved polycarbonate canopy, which officials said will shield 68,000 spectators from rain while preserving open-air acoustics. The ministry’s project memo says the design was selected in March after a closed competition involving seven firms. Vasquez-Hart, 44, was previously named in the department’s records as lead designer for the East Quay Transit Hall and the North Meridian library expansion.
